row: Hey Guys! It’s Sidney! Welcome to my channel! I have began to transition my channel into an online community where I can teach other equestrians how to navigate the Equine World! I plan to share my experiences and adventures that I go on! I will also use my page to showcase my project horses that I train and use this format to help market them! I am always open to video ideas so feel free to reach out with questions and comments!! I want this to be a positive area so please keep negativity to yourself! I hope you guys enjoy my channel!
